fitted_on.code: vitaldb-resolution 0.6.0 (tag v0.6.0): tools/fit_timestamps.py, tools/fit_volume.py, tools/fit_logt.py, tools/reevaluate_fit.py
fitted_on.seed_note: deterministic optimisers (no random draws in fitting)

supersedes.reason: fit block re-evaluated with the library likelihood; parameters unchanged

resolution.justification: Two scale resolutions are present (0.05 and 0.1 kg); modelled as modes rather than overridden.

population.repeat_cases: later cases often copy the weight; use the first-case posterior

special_values.off_grid: 5 values finer than 0.05 kg are flagged off_grid and rounded to 0.05 before evaluation

flags.possibly_written_in: posterior weight of whole_kg; > 0 only for whole kilograms

measured.basis: Day-to-day SD of body weight ~0.5% (range 0.4-0.8%) around its trend (Khosla & Billewicz 1964); evening weights ~1 kg above morning in one subject; same-time weights in hospital inpatients vary by <=0.4 kg (Vivanti et al. 2013). Clothing not included.

written_in.basis: 2018 Korea Community Health Survey, 177,839 adults; limits of agreement -4.80 to 5.84 kg give SD ~2.7 kg. Assumes written-in weights are self-reported. True weight = recorded - bias.

references: Khosla T, Billewicz WZ. Measurement of change in body-weight. Br J Nutr. 1964;18(1):227-239. doi:10.1079/BJN19640022
Vivanti A, Yu L, Palmer M, Dakin L, Sun J, Campbell K. Short-term body weight fluctuations in older well-hydrated hospitalised patients. J Hum Nutr Diet. 2013;26(5):429-435. doi:10.1111/jhn.12034
